title: Claim
description: A proposition that can be supported, attacked, or revised within the CCSR protocol.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this claim belongs to.

author_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that authored this claim.

text.description: The textual content of the claim.

status.description: Current status of the claim in the reasoning lifecycle.

requires_evidence.description: Whether this claim requires evidence to be considered supported.

evidence_status.description: Status of evidence supporting this claim.

parent_claim_id.description: ID of the parent claim if this is a revision, or null.

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejection if status is rejected, or null.

score_logic.description: Logic quality score, or null if not yet scored.

score_evidence.description: Evidence quality score, or null if not yet scored.

score_feasibility.description: Feasibility score, or null if not yet scored.

score_critic_resistance.description: Resistance to criticism score, or null if not yet scored.

score_risk_adjusted.description: Risk-adjusted score, or null if not yet scored.

score_final.description: Final composite score, or null if not yet scored.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this claim.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this claim was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this claim was last updated.
